experiment: Phase 0 Control — Kernel B Only, No Kernel A
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (Ada Lovelace, sm_89)
result: CLEAN — all 4096000 reads returned 0x00000000. Pattern 0xCAFEBABE never appeared.
purpose: Rules out Kernel B self-contaminating its __shared__ buffer. Confirms 0xCAFEBABE appears if and only if Kernel A ran first in the same process.
framing: Hardware initialises shared memory to zero on first kernel access when no in-process writer preceded it. The 100% residue rate in phase0_residue.json is causally attributable to Kernel A's writes persisting across the kernel boundary.
